column1: # Ukrainian (uk) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context    empty (WordCraft uses no contexts yet)
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\ inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns,
#              and a trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Clean room: translated from the meaning of the English labels in this repository.
# No Microsoft Word or other product localisation was consulted or copied.
# Product, format and technology names (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP …) stay in Latin letters.
# Author: @dmatviichuk with Codex; licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0, like WordCraft.

column2: A free, open-source word processor written from scratch in Rust.\nPart of the Crafting Apps from the ArtCraft team.
column3: Безкоштовний текстовий процесор із відкритим кодом, написаний з нуля мовою Rust.\nЧастина Crafting Apps від команди ArtCraft.

column2: Automatic follows your system's language. Menus and commands change; your documents don't.

column2: AutoSave saves every change to the file (needs a saved document)

column2: Click a border between two cells to merge them. Esc stops.

column2:
Create an interactive outline of your document.

It's a great way to keep track of where you are or quickly move your content around.

To get started, go to the Home tab and apply Heading styles to the headings in your document.
column3:
Створіть інтерактивний план документа.

Так ви зможете легко орієнтуватися в документі й швидко переміщувати його вміст.

Щоб почати, відкрийте вкладку «Основне» й застосуйте стилі заголовків до заголовків у документі.

column2: Drag a rectangle to draw a table, or a line across cells to split them. Esc stops.
column3: Перетягніть прямокутник, щоб намалювати таблицю, або лінію через клітинки, щоб їх розділити. Esc завершує.

column2: Drops all formatting and pastes plain text.

column2: Every command is available to scripts and AI agents: run `wordcraft-cli mcp` for an MCP server, or start the app with `--control <port>` for the JSON control channel.
